common.tagline: Your ward. Your vote. Your proof.
common.demoDataHint: You are seeing sample figures. Live county data appears once the county's database is connected.

a11y.simpleModeHint: No animation, lighter pages. Good for slow phones and weak signal.

home.title: Your county, out in the open.
home.intro: Report a problem, follow every shilling, and vote on what your ward builds next. From any phone.

wardCard.trustHint: 40% how fast reports are answered, 35% projects finished, 25% budgets kept.

home.phoneBody: Dial {code} on any phone to report a problem, check a case, vote or get alerts. No data bundles needed.
home.trustBody: You never need to give your name. We keep the ward, the category and your description. Public pages only ever show totals.
home.moneyBody: See what each ward was promised, what has been spent, and who is doing the work.
home.loopBody: Every report goes to a named department with a deadline. If the deadline passes, it climbs to a supervisor, and the overdue count goes on this page for everyone to see.

map.boundariesNote: Ward outlines shown are indicative until the county loads its official boundaries.
map.pinHint: Drag the map so the pin sits on the problem.

report.title: Report a problem
report.intro: Tell {county} County what is broken. It takes about a minute. You do not need to give your name.
report.addPhotoHint: Optional. Up to 3 photos. We remove location details from photos before they leave your phone.
report.category: What kind of problem is it?
report.categoryHelp: Pick the closest one. An officer will check it.
report.sensitiveNote: This kind of report is sent to the county's integrity desk, not to the department it is about.
report.urgentNote: This is treated as urgent. If someone is in danger right now, call 999 or 112 first.
report.describePlaceholder: For example: A big pothole on the road next to the market. Matatus are swerving into oncoming traffic.
report.describeHelp: Please do not include names or phone numbers. We remove them anyway.
report.callbackBody: Optional. If you add your number we will text you when the status changes. It is stored separately from your report and never shown publicly.
report.callbackConsent: Yes, text me updates about this report.
report.callbackInvalid: Enter a Kenyan mobile number, like 0712 345 678.
privacyBullets: Your name is never asked for.
Photos are stripped of GPS and phone details on your device.
Public pages only show totals by ward and category.
The case reference is safe to share. It shows status, never your details.
report.successBody: It has been sent to the county. Keep this reference to check progress.
report.queuedBody: You are offline. Your report will be sent automatically when the signal returns. Keep this reference.
report.shareText: I reported a problem in {ward}. Case {ref}
report.errorRetry: Your report is safe on this phone. We will keep trying.
report.tooShort: Please add a little more detail (at least 12 characters).

status.title: Check a report
status.intro: Enter the case reference you were given.
status.notFound: We could not find that reference. Check it and try again.
status.linkedProject: This is part of a project
status.noUpdates: No updates yet. You will see them here as the county responds.

offline.banner: You are offline. Reports and votes are saved and will send when you reconnect.

footer.about: County Yangu is the public window into {county} County. It runs on CountyConnect, the county's own service platform.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: No connection. Check your signal and try again.
errors.notFoundTitle: We could not find that page
errors.notFoundBody: The link may be old or mistyped.

projects.title: County projects
projects.intro: Every project the county has published: what it costs, what has been spent, who is building it, and how far along it is.
projects.none: No projects match. Try clearing a filter.
projects.seenSomething: Seen something wrong at this project?
projects.seenSomethingBody: Report a stalled site, poor work or missing funds. It goes straight to the county's integrity desk.

otp.codeHint: We sent a code by SMS to {phone}.
otp.resendIn: You can ask for a new code in {seconds}s
otp.invalidCode: That code is not right. Check the SMS and try again.
otp.expired: That code has expired. Ask for a new one.
otp.rateLimited: Too many tries. Please wait a few minutes.
otp.invalidPhone: Enter a Kenyan mobile number, like 0712 345 678.
otp.why: We only use your number to make sure each person votes once. It is never stored with your choice.
otp.demoHint: Demo mode: any number works, and the code is 123456.

vote.title: Vote for your ward
vote.intro: Every ward decides how part of the county's development money is spent. Pick the one project that matters most to you. One person, one vote.
vote.noCycle: There is no voting round open right now. Check back soon, or get an alert when the next one opens.
vote.chooseWard: Which ward do you live in?
vote.noOptions: No projects have been put forward for this ward yet.
vote.confirmBody: You are voting for “{option}” in {ward}. You cannot change it afterwards.
vote.doneTitle: Thank you. Your vote is counted.
vote.doneQueued: Your vote is saved on this phone and will be sent when you are back online.
vote.alreadyVoted: You have already voted in this round on this phone.
vote.alreadyVotedServer: This number has already voted in this round.
vote.failed: We could not record your vote. Please try again.
vote.ussd: You can also vote by dialling {code}.

alerts.title: Get ward alerts
alerts.intro: Get a short SMS when something changes in your ward: water shut-offs, road works, project milestones, voting rounds. Free to receive.
alerts.doneBody: We will text you about {ward}. Reply STOP to any message to unsubscribe.
alerts.failed: We could not subscribe you. Please try again.
alerts.pushNote: Installed the app? You will get free notifications instead of SMS.

ideas.title: Ideas and petitions
ideas.intro: Propose something for your ward or the county, or add your voice to an idea that is already out there. The county must respond to every idea that gathers support.

form.title: Title
form.titleHint: A short headline, like “Streetlights on Mwiki Road”.
form.body: What should the county do, and why?
form.verify: Confirm your number to send it
form.sent: Thank you. Your idea has been sent.
form.failed: We could not send that. Please try again.

ideas.none: No ideas here yet. Be the first.

tenders.title: Tenders
tenders.intro: Every county tender, in the open: what is being bought, how much it is worth, and who won. Contractors who win a lot are flagged for a closer look.
tenders.redFlagsIntro: Contractors awarded more than 2 tenders. This is a prompt to look closer, not a finding of wrongdoing.

pulse.title: County Pulse
pulse.intro: How the county is really doing, in the open. Live figures on responsiveness, delivery and participation. Only totals are shown: never names, never who reported what.
pulse.trustFormula: 40% how fast reports are answered, 35% projects finished, 25% budgets kept.
pulse.leagueSub: Higher is better. Based on the last 90 days.
pulse.channelSub: Share of reports by channel, last 90 days
pulse.demoNote: Sample figures shown until the county's database is connected.

how.title: How it works
how.intro: One county, one system, many ways in. Whatever you use, your report or vote lands in the same place and follows the same rules.
how.channelsTitle: Four ways to reach the county
how.webBody: Use this site on any phone. Install it to your home screen and it works even with weak signal: reports wait on your phone and send when you are back online.
how.ussdBody: Dial {code} on any phone. Choose your ward, then report, vote, check a case or get alerts. No data bundles needed.
how.smsBody: Text your report to {code}. We reply with a case reference and tell you when its status changes.
how.voiceBody: Call the county line and speak in English or Swahili. Your message is written down and handled like any other report.
how.ladderIntro: Rules, not moods, decide who is told and when. If a deadline passes, the case climbs, and the overdue count is shown publicly.

ladder.d2: Not acknowledged: a reminder, and their supervisor is copied
ladder.target: Deadline missed: the chief officer is told, and the overdue counter goes up
ladder.targets: Each type of problem has its own deadline
ladder.late30: 30 days late: the CEC member and the Assembly committee, by name
ladder.monthly: Every month: a digest to the Auditor-General and Controller of Budget

how.ladderNote: Artificial intelligence helps to sort and summarise reports. It never decides who gets escalated, and it never approves anything.
how.privacyIntro: Reporting is anonymous by design. Voting needs a phone check, so it is kept completely separate from reports.
weKeepList: The ward, category and description of your report.
A case reference and its status history.
Photos, with location and phone details removed on your phone before upload.
If you ask for SMS updates: your number, stored separately and never shown publicly.
weNeverList: Ask for your name on a report.
Show your number, or anything that identifies you, on any public page.
Join your votes to your reports.
Let artificial intelligence make a decision about you.
how.rightsBody: Under the Data Protection Act you can ask what we hold about you, ask for corrections, or ask us to delete it. Write to the county's Data Protection Officer or dial {code}.
how.accessBody: English and Kiswahili, large text, high contrast, a simple mode for slow phones, and every action available without a smartphone.

auth.signInIntro: Apply for permits, pay county fees and track your applications. You only need an account for these. Reporting, voting and alerts stay open to everyone.
auth.name: Full name
auth.checkEmailBody: We sent a link to {email}. Open it to finish creating your account.

errors.invalid: Email or password is not right.
errors.exists: An account with this email already exists. Try signing in.
errors.weak: Choose a stronger password (at least 8 characters).
errors.unconfirmed: Confirm your email first. Check your inbox.
errors.generic: We could not do that. Please try again.

auth.demoNote: Demo mode: any password works, and your data stays on this device.
auth.staffNote: Are you county staff? Use the staff sign-in instead.

services.title: My Services
services.intro: Apply for permits and licences, pay county fees with M-Pesa, and follow every application, all in one place.

apply_.kraPinHint: Format: A123456789Z. We only check that you are tax compliant.
apply_.kraInvalid: That does not look like a KRA PIN.
apply_.docsHint: Photos or PDF, up to 8 MB each. Photos are shrunk on your phone.
apply_.draftNote: Your progress is saved as a draft.

pay.title: Pay with M-Pesa
pay.waitingBody: Enter your M-Pesa PIN to pay {amount}. This page updates by itself.
pay.doneBody: Receipt {receipt}. Your application is with the county.
pay.failedBody: You have not been charged. Try again.
pay.timeout: We did not hear back from M-Pesa. If you were charged, contact the county with your receipt.

app.title: My applications
app.notFound: We could not find that application.

notif.title: Notifications
notif.none: Nothing yet. Updates about your applications will appear here.
